=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text minus "-"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note emitw writes n right-aligned in w columns (w at most 20; a wider number is not cut)
fn emitw n ulong w ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 32
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
if gt w sub 20 i
i = sub 20 w
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note row r (from 0) holds r+1 consecutive numbers; column j is as wide as the last row's entry in
note column j, which is the widest in that column
fn digits v ulong to ulong
d = ulong 1
while ge v 10 bound 20
v = div v 10
d = add d 1
end
ret d
end
fn floyd n ulong to void
last = add div mul sub n 1 n 2 1
k = ulong 1
for r ulong n
for j ulong add r 1
w = digits add last j
if gt j 0
emit sp
end
emitw k w
k = add k 1
end
emit nl
end
end
fn main to int
floyd 5
emit nl
floyd 14
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
